$comment: ADR-0001 content-transport benchmark — the preregistered constants (resolution plan §4.3 step 1, §4.4, §4.5, §4.8). Every value is LITERAL by design: the workload is a function of (config, repo, SHA) and all three are pinned. Values marked 'production literal' mirror module-local constants in scripts/*.ts and are cross-checked by benchConfig.test.ts where the production symbol is exported. After §8 ratification this file is FROZEN — any change invalidates affected timing data and requires a plan amendment plus one adversarial review round.

selection.$comment: The production selection function's pinned inputs (§4.3): scanUnit/locateManifests/classifyFile are reused directly, so the classifier terms are the production code itself; these are the config-shaped inputs it takes. trackedPackages is finalised at corpus pinning (pre-freeze) so C1/C2 workloads carry a non-trivial source class; the committed value here is what every selected/*.json was generated from.

restFallbackBudget.$comment: Per-unit REST fallback budget, EVERY driver (§4.4): max(floor, ceil(fractionOfSelected × selected)). Exhaustion is a unit failure (G2).

t1.aliasSelection: object(expression: $EXPR) { __typename ... on Blob { oid byteSize isBinary isTruncated text } }

t2a.$comment: Size-based api-escape (§4.4): a unit whose PINNED REST repository size (KB, recorded in corpus.json at pinning — size rides discovery, which the benchmark excludes as identical across drivers) exceeds this threshold routes to per-file REST with T0 semantics — EXCEPT truncated trees, which must clone anyway (the oversized-and-truncated hole is exhibited, not patched). Derivation: predicted clone+checkout disk ≈ 2 × size, so the escape aligns with the 2 GiB G4 gate at size > 1 GiB = 1048576 KB.

spawn.$comment: production literals: SPAWN_TIMEOUT_MS / SPAWN_KILL_GRACE_MS are exported and cross-checked; outputCapBytes mirrors github.ts's module-local MAX_SPAWN_OUTPUT_BYTES (110 MiB).

frame.$comment: Framed seam limits (§3.1/§3.2). frameCeilingBytes = production's spawn-output cap, the absolute per-frame ceiling; the per-frame bound is the ls-tree-declared size exactly. childPoolSize = the subprocess semaphore's production default (§3.1 — a small fixed pool, never one-per-unit).

protocol.$comment: §4.5. Cold = no api_cache rows, no reused clones, no HTTP cache; DNS/TLS warmth is ambient. Washout = max(floorMs, longest outstanding throttle horizon from the previous run). Temp prefix pa-bench-* — NOT pkg-audit-*, which production's startup sweep deletes unconditionally (github.ts:2096).

budget.$comment: §4.8 worst-case reservation. P_max is a FROZEN ASSUMPTION: any measured per-request cost above it, or any run overrunning its own WC, halts the matrix (R5 freeze repair). rate_limit reads are excluded (documented as not counting against the REST primary limit). Formulas (evaluated in benchBudget.ts): REST WC_core = (contentRequests + treeRequests + fallbackBudget) × attemptCap + fixedPerRunOverheadRequests; GraphQL WC_graphql = plannedBatches × (1 + maxDescendantsPerOriginal) × attemptCap × pMax.

noiseBand.$comment: §4.7: band = max(floor, pilot max/min wall ratio rounded UP to the next roundUpTo).

williamsFifthRowNote: Rows 1-4 are a digram-balanced 4×4 Williams square (each driver once per position; each ordered predecessor pair exactly once). Row 5 is the declared fifth order: its three digrams (T0→T2a, T2a→T1, T1→T2c) each already occur exactly once in rows 1-4, so no ordered pair reaches three occurrences — the minimum any fifth row can achieve.

scaffolding.$comment: SHA-pinned acquisition scaffolding (§4.4) — bench scaffolding, NOT proposed production grammar. Slots in {braces} are substituted before the spawn module compares argv verbatim. The gitconfig is the bench's pinned generated config (mirroring production's ensureGitConfig approach: credential helper delegating to gh, https-only protocol) plus the ONE probe-varied knob, core.autocrlf (baseline false; the checkout-config probe rep runs true).
scaffolding.gitconfigBaseline:
[credential]
	helper = !{ghBin} auth git-credential
[protocol]
	allow = never
[protocol "https"]
	allow = always
[core]
	autocrlf = false
scaffolding.gitconfigProbeAutocrlfTrue:
[credential]
	helper = !{ghBin} auth git-credential
[protocol]
	allow = never
[protocol "https"]
	allow = always
[core]
	autocrlf = true
